svg.title: Sonya Raber and Floyd Balliet: known links and a candidate older household
svg.desc: On the left, Justin's family account names Sonya's father William John Raber and grandfather William G. Raber, whose middle name conflicts between George and Glenmore. On the right, a Donald Balliet obituary names parents Stanley and Crystal and eleven siblings including Floyd. The dotted arrow to Sonya's Floyd A. Balliet marks an unproved identity match. Sources are linked in the branch note.
